excludePatterns.label: Exclude patterns (one per line)
excludePatterns.help: Glob patterns, * wildcard. Lines starting with # are comments. Empty = filter off.

verboseFilterLog.label: Verbose filter logging
verboseFilterLog.help: When enabled, log each excluded entity_id individually during the initial adapter sync (requires loglevel info or debug).

cleanupExcludedOnStart.label: Cleanup excluded entities on adapter start
cleanupExcludedOnStart.help: When enabled, on each adapter start delete existing objects under entities.* whose entity_id matches the exclude patterns. Objects with custom adapter config (history/influxdb/sql) are kept and logged.
